reports.verdict: CoreWeave beat on profit and raised its 2026 outlook, with its order backlog jumping to about $133B. Losses and debt costs keep growing.

takeaways.label: Profit well above plan
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income was about $379M, far above the company's $200–260M target, on revenue of about $3.7B, up 168% from a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Higher full-year outlook
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13–13.3B from $12.4–13.2B, above analysts' roughly $12.9B. Management expects to exit the year at a $20–21B annualized revenue pace.

takeaways.label: Backlog jumped again
takeaways.text: Contracted backlog reached about $132.5B, up from about $104B at June 30, which suggests AI demand hasn't slowed.

takeaways.label: Losses and debt costs persist
takeaways.text: Net loss widened to $709M from $110M a year ago. Most of the remaining build-out is to be funded with more borrowing tied to customer contracts.

reports.verdict: Trump Media's $409.7 million profit came entirely from non-cash digital-asset gains; the media business still lost money, and the TAE merger vote is set for December 14.

takeaways.label: Profit is bitcoin, not business
takeaways.text: Net income of $409.7 million rested on $496.1 million of non-cash gains on digital assets and securities. Adjusted EBITDA, a measure of operating results, was still a $12.3 million loss.

takeaways.label: Revenue tripled, still tiny
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 205% to $3.0 million, mostly from subscriptions, including Truth API, a data product launched August 1. It is small next to $2.5 billion in total assets.

takeaways.label: TAE merger on track
takeaways.text: The SEC declared the merger filing effective November 5. Shareholders vote December 14, and the company still targets closing in Q4 2026, pending approvals.

takeaways.label: Legal drag fading
takeaways.text: Legal fees fell to $2.4 million from $20.3 million a year earlier after old legal matters were resolved. Management also promised a more disciplined approach to managing its digital assets.

reports.verdict: Berkshire's core profit slipped as GEICO weakened, but its $9.6 billion buyback shows Greg Abel will spend the cash pile more readily than Buffett did.

takeaways.label: Buybacks accelerate
takeaways.text: Berkshire repurchased $9.6 billion of its own stock, more than double last quarter's $4.5 billion, and about $14.4 billion so far this year.

takeaways.label: GEICO profit squeezed
takeaways.text: Insurance underwriting profit fell 43% to $1.35 billion. GEICO's pre-tax profit nearly halved as accident claims and advertising costs rose, and analysts point to lower prices aimed at winning back customers.

takeaways.label: Other businesses grew
takeaways.text: Rail, utilities and manufacturing all earned more than a year ago, but not enough to offset weaker insurance and lower interest income. Operating earnings fell 5.8% to $12.7 billion.

takeaways.label: Cash still enormous
takeaways.text: Reuters puts cash and equivalents at about $357 billion at quarter-end. Net earnings fell 28% to $22.1 billion because stock-portfolio gains were smaller than last year.

reports.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, but its majority owner LS Power has offered $2.00 a share to take it private.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue is now expected at $375-400M, down from $400-430M in August. The expected adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $15-30M. Management blamed slower EV sales and a weak summer.

takeaways.label: LS Power buyout offer
takeaways.text: LS Power, the majority owner, proposed buying the shares it doesn't own for $2.00 cash, about a 59% premium to the prior close. A special committee is reviewing it, with no decision yet.

takeaways.label: Charging growing, but less used
takeaways.text: Charging revenue rose 29% to $72M, but daily use per stall fell 4% to 283 kWh as automaker charging credits expired. Excluding those, use rose 7%.

takeaways.label: Spending pulled back
takeaways.text: Management plans about $100M less building spending in 2026, shifting some stalls into 2027. Net loss still widened to $49M, but available liquidity is about $787M.
